decision: Keep _CompoundClearingBrakeCarryController as the active bare Agent route. The candidate gained six finishes on fresh local official-generator geometries but increased paired collisions and damage on seven cells, violating the preregistered safety veto. Do not freeze a finalist or open confirmation/blind.

screen.independent_audit: All 68 envelopes and hashes, every required cell, both deterministic repeat pairs, the recomputed summary, and init/reset/action/RSS gates passed. Maximum observed initialization 2698 ms, reset 0.128 ms, action 107 ms, peak worker RSS 237.7 MiB.

source_bound_failure_trace.interpretation: The ego-position side rule corrected some reused cases but suppressed beneficial baseline switches on two new geometries. A useful pass choice needs observed road and obstacle clearance, vehicle width, and enough distance to change trajectory. These traces identify the divergence, not a validated replacement policy.

limits: The four track IDs share each seed's geometry; this screen has eight independent geometry seeds, not 32 independent tracks. Finite local official-generator evidence does not prove all-track performance. No later partition was evaluated or reused.
